state_verbs_note.title: ⚠️ State Verbs (Durum Fiilleri) Kuralı
state_verbs_note.desc: Düşünce, his, sahiplik veya duyu bildiren durum fiilleri 'şimdiki zaman' anlamında olsalar bile -ing takısı ALMAZLAR, Present Simple ile kullanılırlar.

examples.en: She usually walks to school, but today she is taking the bus.
examples.tr: O genellikle okula yürür, ama bugün otobüse biniyor.

examples.en: I understand the grammar rules very well right now.

examples.en: Look! The students are working on their science project.
examples.tr: Bak! Öğrenciler fen projeleri üzerinde çalışıyorlar.

examples.en: This blue backpack belongs to my classmate Leo.
examples.tr: Bu mavi sırt çantası sınıf arkadaşım Leo'ya ait.

pitfalls.wrong: I am knowing the answer right now.
pitfalls.correct: I know the answer right now.
pitfalls.explanation: 'Know' bir durum fiilidir (state verb), şimdiki zamanda dahi -ing eki alamaz.
He / She / It öznelerinde olumsuz cümle 'doesn't' yardımcı fiili ile kurulur.

formula_cards.usage: Geçmişte belirli bir zamanda başlayıp tamamlanmış anlık eylemler.
formula_cards.keywords: yesterday, last night/week/year, two days ago, in 2020

formula_cards.usage: Geçmişte belirli bir anda devam etmekte olan uzun süreçli eylemler.
formula_cards.keywords: at 8 o'clock yesterday, while, as, all day yesterday

state_verbs_note.title: ⚡ When & While Altın Kuralı
state_verbs_note.desc:
• WHILE + Past Continuous (Uzun eylem): 'While I was studying...' (Ders çalışıyorken...)
• WHEN + Past Simple (Kısa/kesen eylem): '...when the telephone rang.' (...telefon çaldığında.)

examples.en: While Ela was reading in the library, her phone rang.
examples.tr: Ela kütüphanede kitap okurken telefonu çaldı.

examples.en: When the teacher entered the classroom, the students were talking.
examples.tr: Öğretmen sınıfa girdiğinde öğrenciler konuşuyordu.

examples.en: I didn't watch the football match yesterday evening.
examples.tr: Dün akşam futbol maçını izlemedim.

examples.en: What were you doing at 10 PM last night?
examples.tr: Dün gece saat 22:00'de ne yapıyordun?

pitfalls.wrong: While I was walking, I was seeing a strange bird.
pitfalls.correct: While I was walking, I saw a strange bird.
pitfalls.explanation: Kısa ve anlık eylemler (görmek, düşmek, aramak) Past Simple (V2) olmalıdır.

pitfalls.wrong: Did you saw the new art gallery?
pitfalls.correct: Did you see the new art gallery?
pitfalls.explanation: 'Did' yardımcı fiili kullanıldığında ana fiil daima yalın (V1) haline döner.

formula_cards.usage: Geçmişte olmuş ama zamanı belirtilmemiş, etkisi veya sonucu şu an devam eden olaylar ya da hayat tecrübeleri.
formula_cards.keywords: just (henüz), already (zaten), yet (henüz-olumsuz/soru), since (den beri), for (dır), ever, never

formula_cards.tense: Past Simple vs. Present Perfect Ayrımı
formula_cards.usage: Zaman belliyse (yesterday, in 2018) -> Past Simple (V2). Zaman belirsiz veya tecrübe ise -> Present Perfect (have/has V3).
formula_cards.pos_formula: Past Simple: I visited Rome in 2021. (Belli zaman)
formula_cards.neg_formula: Present Perfect: I have visited Rome twice. (Hayat tecrübesi)
formula_cards.que_formula: Have you ever been to London? - Yes, I went there last summer.
formula_cards.keywords: Since 2015 vs. In 2015, For 3 years vs. 3 years ago

state_verbs_note.title: 📌 Ever / Never & Just / Already / Yet Kuralları
state_verbs_note.desc:
• Ever: Soru cümlelerinde tecrübe sorarken ('Have you ever eaten sushi?')
• Never: Olumlu yapılı cümlede olumsuz anlam ('I have never been abroad.')
• Yet: Cümlenin en sonunda ve sadece olumsuz ya da sorularda kullanılır ('I haven't finished yet.')

examples.en: I have already booked my flight ticket to London.
examples.tr: Londra uçak biletimi şimdiden (çoktan) aldım.

examples.en: She hasn't packed her travel suitcase yet.
examples.tr: Valizini henüz hazırlamadı.

examples.en: They have lived in this historic neighborhood since 2018.
examples.tr: 2018'den beri bu tarihi mahallede yaşıyorlar.

examples.en: We visited the ancient museum yesterday. (Past Simple - zaman net)
examples.tr: Dün antik müzeyi ziyaret ettik.

pitfalls.explanation: 'Yesterday' kesin geçmiş zaman bildirdiği için Present Perfect değil, Past Simple (saw) kullanılır.

pitfalls.wrong: She has already not called me.
pitfalls.explanation: Olumsuz cümlelerde 'already' yerine cümlenin sonunda 'yet' kullanılır.

formula_cards.usage: Konuşma anında verilen ani kararlar, sözler, teklifler ve kişisel tahminler.
formula_cards.keywords: I think, I believe, probably, maybe, I promise, suddenly

formula_cards.tense: Be Going To (Önceden Plan & Güçlü Kanıt)
formula_cards.usage: Önceden planlanmış niyetler veya şu anki somut kanıtlara dayanan tahminler.
formula_cards.pos_formula: Subject + am / is / are + going to + Verb-1
formula_cards.neg_formula: Subject + am not / isn't / aren't + going to + Verb-1
formula_cards.que_formula: Am / Is / Are + Subject + going to + Verb-1 ?
formula_cards.keywords: plan, intend, Look at the dark clouds!, carefully

state_verbs_note.title: 🔮 Modals of Probability (May, Might, Could)
state_verbs_note.desc:
Geleceğe veya şu ana dair olasılık bildirmek için kullanılır:
• May / Might / Could + Verb1 (%40-50 ihtimal)
• Must + Verb1 (%90 güçlü çıkarım: 'He must be at school.')

examples.en: Look at those black clouds! It is going to rain. (Somut kanıt var)
examples.tr: Şu kara bulutlara bak! Yağmur yağacak.

examples.en: I think artificial intelligence will create exciting new jobs.
examples.tr: Bence yapay zeka heyecan verici yeni işler yaratacak. (Kişisel tahmin)

examples.en: The phone is ringing. - I will answer it! (Ani karar)
examples.tr: Telefon çalıyor. - Ben bakarım!

examples.en: We are meeting the computer science teacher tomorrow at 10 AM.
examples.tr: Yarın sabah saat 10'da bilgisayar öğretmeniyle buluşuyoruz. (Kesin randevu)

pitfalls.wrong: Look at the ice on the road! You will slip.
pitfalls.correct: Look at the ice on the road! You are going to slip.
pitfalls.explanation: Gözümüzün önünde somut bir kanıt (buz) olduğunda 'be going to' kullanılır.

pitfalls.wrong: I will to study computer science.
pitfalls.explanation: 'Will' modal fiilinden sonra 'to' gelmez, fiil doğrudan yalın (V1) kullanılır.

units.title: Unit 4: Society, Rules & Global Citizenship
units.grammar_focus: Modals of Obligation, Prohibition & Advice (Must, Have to, Should, Musn't, Don't have to)

words.example: Active digital citizenship means respecting privacy and online rights.
Traffic regulations are designed to protect pedestrians and drivers.
Wearing safety goggles is mandatory in the science laboratory.
School rules prohibit using smartphones during examinations.
High school students often volunteer at environmental clean-up events.
Education promotes social equality and fair opportunities for all.
Protecting nature is a shared global responsibility.
Athletes must comply with fair play guidelines during matches.
Citizens gathered peacefully to protest against deforestation.
Cheating in exams carries serious disciplinary punishments.

units.grammar_summary: Zorunluluk (Must / Have to), yasaklama (Musn't), gereksizlik (Don't have to) ve tavsiye (Should) kipleri.

reading_passage.title: Being an Active Global Citizen
reading_passage.text: Every civilized society relies on rules and regulations to maintain order. While citizens have rights, they also have important responsibilities. In schools, students must comply with safety codes and show mutual respect. When young people volunteer and stand up for environmental causes, they build a better future for everyone.

formula_cards.usage:
• Must: Konuşmacının kendi içinden gelen güçlü zorunluluk veya kural.
• Have to: Dışarıdan gelen resmi kurallar, kanunlar ve okul kuralları.
formula_cards.pos_formula: Subject + must / have to / has to + Verb-1
formula_cards.que_formula: Do / Does + Subject + have to + Verb-1 ?

formula_cards.usage: Birine yapması iyi olacak bir tavsiyede veya öğütte bulunurken kullanılır.
formula_cards.keywords: I advise you, If I were you, good idea, suggestion

state_verbs_note.title: ⚠️ EN ÇOK KARIŞTIRILAN FARK: Musn't vs. Don't Have To
state_verbs_note.desc:
• MUSTN'T: Kesinlikle YASAK! Yaparsan ceza alırsın ('You mustn't cheat in exams.')
• DON'T HAVE TO: Zorunda değilsin, istersen yapabilirsin ('You don't have to wake up early on Sundays.')
verbs: Don't have to = İsteğe bağlı (No obligation)

examples.en: Students must follow the digital citizenship rules in the lab.
examples.tr: Öğrenciler laboratuvarda dijital vatandaşlık kurallarına uymalıdır.

examples.en: You mustn't share your private passwords with strangers. (Yasak)
examples.tr: Özel şifrelerinizi yabancılarla kesinlikle paylaşmamalısınız.

examples.en: Tomorrow is Sunday, so Ela doesn't have to wake up early.
examples.tr: Yarın pazar, bu yüzden Ela erken kalkmak zorunda değil.

examples.en: You should practice speaking English every day.
examples.tr: Her gün İngilizce konuşma pratiği yapmalısın. (Tavsiye)

pitfalls.wrong: You mustn't pay for the museum, it is free.
pitfalls.correct: You don't have to pay for the museum, it is free.
pitfalls.explanation: Müze ücretsizse 'ödemek zorunda değilsin' denir (don't have to). 'Mustn't' derseniz para ödemek yasaktır anlamına gelir.

pitfalls.wrong: He must to respect other people.
pitfalls.explanation: Must modalından sonra asla 'to' kullanılmaz, fiil yalın gelir.

formula_cards.usage:
• Kısa sıfatlar: faster than / the fastest
• Uzun sıfatlar: more energetic than / the most energetic
• Düzensizler: good->better->best, bad->worse->worst
formula_cards.pos_formula: Comparative: A is more [adj] than B | Superlative: A is the most [adj]
formula_cards.neg_formula: As...as: A is not as tall as B (A, B kadar uzun değil)
formula_cards.que_formula: Which sport is more challenging, tennis or swimming?
formula_cards.keywords: than, the most, the -est, as...as, much more

formula_cards.usage:
• TOO + Sıfat (Gereğinden fazla/olumsuz aşırı): 'too expensive' (fazla pahalı)
• Sıfat + ENOUGH (Yeterli derecede): 'healthy enough' (yeterince sağlıklı)
formula_cards.pos_formula: too + adjective + (to V1) | adjective + enough + (to V1)
formula_cards.que_formula: Is this water warm enough to swim?

state_verbs_note.title: ⭐ Düzensiz Sıfatlar Tablosu (Irregular Adjectives)
state_verbs_note.desc:
• good -> better -> the best (iyi / daha iyi / en iyi)
• bad -> worse -> the worst (kötü / daha kötü / en kötü)
• far -> farther/further -> the farthest/furthest (uzak)
• little -> less -> the least (az / daha az / en az)
• many/much -> more -> the most (çok / daha çok / en çok)

examples.en: Swimming is more beneficial for your posture than running.
examples.tr: Yüzme, duruşunuz için koşmaktan daha faydalıdır.

examples.en: Ela is the most hardworking student in the ninth grade.
examples.tr: Ela, dokuzuncu sınıftaki en çalışkan öğrencidir.

examples.en: This soup is too hot to drink right now.
examples.tr: Bu çorba şu an içmek için aşırı sıcak.

examples.en: He is not strong enough to lift that heavy fitness bar.
examples.tr: O ağır fitness barını kaldırmak için yeterince güçlü değil.

pitfalls.wrong: She is more taller than her brother.
pitfalls.correct: She is taller than her brother.
pitfalls.explanation: Kısa tek heceli sıfatlara hem 'more' hem de '-er' aynı anda eklenmez.
'Enough' kelimesi sıfatlardan SONRA gelir (fast enough), isimlerden ÖNCE gelir (enough money).

words.example: The movie won an Oscar for its breathtaking cinematography.
The director wrote an original screenplay based on true historical events.
Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa is considered a worldwide masterpiece.
The orchestral symphony captivated the entire concert hall.
The emotional soundtrack enhanced the drama of the final scene.
Hollywood stars attended the glamorous film premiere in London.
The championship match was broadcast live across fifty countries.
Science fiction is my favorite cinematic genre.
Film critics praised the lead actress for her powerful performance.
The modern art gallery is hosting an interactive photography exhibition.

formula_cards.usage: İşi yapanın değil, yapılan işin veya nesnenin önemli olduğu genel durumlar.
formula_cards.pos_formula: Object + am / is / are + Verb-3 (Past Participle)
formula_cards.neg_formula: Object + am not / isn't / aren't + Verb-3
formula_cards.keywords: by (tarafından), is produced, are made, is spoken

formula_cards.usage: Geçmişte gerçekleşen ve etkilenen nesnenin ön planda olduğu durumlar.
formula_cards.keywords: was written in 1990, were invented, was directed by

state_verbs_note.title: 🎨 Aktif Cümleyi Edilgene Çevirme Adımları
state_verbs_note.desc:
1. Aktif cümlenin Nesnesini (Object) başa alıp yeni Özne yap.
2. Zamana uygun 'Be' fiilini koy (is/are veya was/were).
3. Ana fiilin daima 3. halini (V3) kullan.
4. İşi yapanı belirtmek istersen cümlenin sonuna '+ by ...' ekle.
verbs: Passive: Hamlet was written by Shakespeare.

examples.en: English is spoken by millions of students around the world.
examples.tr: İngilizce, dünya genelinde milyonlarca öğrenci tarafından konuşulur.

examples.en: The famous cinema movie was directed by Christopher Nolan.
examples.tr: Ünlü sinema filmi Christopher Nolan tarafından yönetildi.

examples.en: These classical sculptures are protected in the museum.
examples.tr: Bu klasik heykeller müzede korunmaktadır.

examples.en: The Mona Lisa was painted in the 16th century.
examples.tr: Mona Lisa tablosu 16. yüzyılda yapıldı.

pitfalls.wrong: The new film was directed with a famous artist.
pitfalls.correct: The new film was directed by a famous artist.
pitfalls.explanation: Edilgen cümlelerde işi yapan kişiyi belirtirken 'with' değil 'by' bağlacı kullanılır.
Edilgen çatıda fiil daima 3. halinde (V3) olmak zorundadır.

units.title: Unit 7: Environment, Eco-Warriors & Climate Action
units.grammar_focus: Conditionals (Zero & First Conditional - If Clauses) & Future Time Clauses

words.example: Protecting tropical rainforests preserves planetary biodiversity.
Cycling to school significantly reduces your personal carbon footprint.
Solar and geothermal energy are clean, renewable power sources.
Climate change threatens hundreds of marine species with extinction.
Industrial deforestation harms natural animal habitats.
We must conserve fresh drinking water during hot summer months.
Plastic bags take over five hundred years to decompose in nature.
Air pollution in major metropolitan cities causes respiratory problems.
Youth activists advocate for immediate climate action treaties.
Recycling materials supports a circular and sustainable economy.

units.grammar_summary: Genel doğa kanunları (Tip 0: If + Present, Present) ile gelecekteki gerçekçi olasılıklar (Tip 1: If + Present, Will) ve Unless.

reading_passage.title: Guardians of the Green Planet
reading_passage.text: Environmental scientists declared that global temperatures had risen at an alarming rate. In order to protect endangered ecosystems, eco-friendly communities are reducing single-use plastics and investing in renewable solar arrays so that future generations can inherit a clean and healthy planet.

formula_cards.tense: Zero Conditional (Genel Doğa Kanunları & Bilimsel Gerçekler)
formula_cards.usage: Her zaman doğru olan bilimsel kurallar veya kesin sonuçlar.
formula_cards.neg_formula: If you don't water plants, they die.
formula_cards.que_formula: What happens if water reaches 100 degrees?

formula_cards.usage: Gelecekte gerçekleşmesi muhtemel olan durumlar ve olası sonuçları.
formula_cards.pos_formula: If + Present Simple, will / won't + Verb-1
formula_cards.neg_formula: If we don't reduce plastic waste, pollution will increase.
formula_cards.que_formula: What will you do if it rains tomorrow?
formula_cards.keywords: if, unless (if not), as soon as, when, in case

state_verbs_note.title: 🌱 UNLESS = IF NOT (Madıkça / Medikçe)
state_verbs_note.desc:
• 'Unless we protect the forests, wildlife will disappear.'
(Ormanları korumadıkça yaban hayatı yok olacak.)
= 'If we do not protect the forests, wildlife will disappear.'

examples.en: If we use renewable energy, we will reduce our carbon footprint.
examples.tr: Eğer yenilenebilir enerji kullanırsak, karbon ayak izimizi azaltacağız.

examples.en: If you heat ice, it melts. (Zero conditional - bilimsel gerçek)
examples.tr: Buzu ısıtırsan erir.

examples.en: Unless we plant more trees, global temperatures will continue to rise.
examples.tr: Daha fazla ağaç dikmedikçe küresel sıcaklıklar artmaya devam edecek.

examples.en: As soon as I finish my homework, I will help you with the recycling project.
examples.tr: Ödevimi bitirir bitirmez geri dönüşüm projesinde sana yardım edeceğim.

pitfalls.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
pitfalls.correct: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
pitfalls.explanation: 'If' cümlesinin içine asla 'will' gelmez, daima Present Simple kullanılır.

pitfalls.wrong: Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the school bus.
pitfalls.correct: Unless you hurry, you will miss the school bus.
pitfalls.explanation: 'Unless' kendi içinde zaten olumsuzluk (if not) barındırır, tekrar 'don't' kullanılmaz.

words.example: The young entrepreneur developed a successful mobile study app.

Today's dynamic workplace values individuals who enjoy collaborating on complex tasks and never avoid learning new technologies. If you manage to cultivate perseverance and adaptability, you can pursue your wildest ambitions and achieve worldwide success.

formula_cards.usage:
İki cümleyi birbirine bağlayıp bir ismi nitelemek için kullanılır:
• WHO / THAT: İnsanlar için ('The teacher who inspires us...')
• WHICH / THAT: Hayvanlar ve nesneler için ('The software which analyze data...')
• WHERE: Mekanlar ve yerler için ('The university where I study...')
• WHOSE: Sahiplik bildirenler için ('The student whose project won the award...')
formula_cards.pos_formula: Noun + [who / which / that / where / whose] + Clause
formula_cards.neg_formula: I met a scientist who doesn't use standard algorithms.
formula_cards.que_formula: Do you know the architect who designed this eco-building?
formula_cards.keywords: who (insan), which (nesne), that (her ikisi), where (yer), whose (aitlik)

formula_cards.usage: Geçmişte düzenli olarak yapılan ama artık terk edilmiş olan eski alışkanlıklar ve durumlar.
formula_cards.keywords: in the past, when I was a child, no longer, anymore

state_verbs_note.title: 💼 Geleceğin Mesleklerinde Sıfat Cümlecikleri
state_verbs_note.desc:
• 'An AI engineer is a specialist WHO designs intelligent systems.'
• 'A sustainable farm is a place WHERE crops are grown without chemical pesticides.'

examples.en: An astronaut is a professional who explores outer space.
examples.tr: Astronot, uzayı keşfeden profesyonel bir kişidir.

examples.en: This is the innovative company that developed the new eco-engine.
examples.tr: Bu, yeni çevre dostu motoru geliştiren yenilikçi şirkettir.

examples.en: I used to play video games for hours, but now I focus on coding.
examples.tr: Eskiden saatlerce video oyunu oynardım, ama şimdi kodlamaya odaklanıyorum.

examples.en: Did your father use to work in an international office?
examples.tr: Baban eskiden uluslararası bir ofiste mi çalışırdı?

pitfalls.wrong: I met a girl which speaks four languages.
pitfalls.correct: I met a girl who speaks four languages.

pitfalls.wrong: She didn't used to like science fiction.
pitfalls.correct: She didn't use to like science fiction.
pitfalls.explanation: 'Didn't' kullanıldığında 'used' fiilindeki -d eki düşer ve 'use to' haline döner.

bookworms_library.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Blue Diamond
bookworms_library.author: Sir Arthur Conan Doyle
bookworms_library.summary: Sherlock Holmes ve Dr. Watson'ın Noel gününde çalınan paha biçilmez mavi elmasın izini Londra sokaklarında sürdüğü klasik dedektiflik macerası.

chapters.title: An Old Hat and a Fat Goose
chapters.text: It was two days after Christmas, and I went to visit my friend Sherlock Holmes. He was sitting in his armchair with an old brown felt hat in his hands. 'What is that?' I asked. 'A clue to a terrible crime?' Holmes smiled and said, 'No, Watson. It is just an ordinary hat, but behind it lies a fascinating human story.'

chapters.title: The Countess's Stolen Diamond
chapters.text: The Countess of Morcar lost her famous blue diamond from her hotel room five days ago. The police arrested a young plumber named John Horner, who was working in the room. But Holmes looked carefully at the evidence and realized that the real thief was still walking freely on the streets of London.

bookworms_library.title: The Phantom of the Opera
bookworms_library.author: Gaston Leroux
bookworms_library.summary: Paris Operası'nın altındaki gizli tünellerde yaşayan gizemli hayalet ve güzel opera şarkıcısı Christine Daaé'nin dramatik hikayesi.

chapters.title: The Opera House Ghost
chapters.text: It was a wonderful night at the Paris Opera House. The dancers were ready, and the audience was waiting eagerly. But down in the dark corridors underneath the stage, the staff whispered nervously. 'Did you see him?' asked one of the stage hands. 'The man with the yellow face and black coat? The Opera Ghost is here tonight!'

chapters.title: The Angel of Music
chapters.text: Christine Daaé sang like an angel that evening. Count Raoul de Chagny was in the audience, and he fell in love with her voice immediately. Later in her dressing room, Christine heard a beautiful voice coming from behind the mirror. 'I am your teacher,' the mysterious voice whispered.

bookworms_library.title: Around the World in Eighty Days
bookworms_library.author: Jules Verne
bookworms_library.summary: Phileas Fogg ve sadık yardımcısı Passepartout'nun 80 günde tüm dünyayı dolaşmak üzere giriştikleri nefes kesici macera.

chapters.title: The Twenty-Thousand Pound Wager
chapters.text: In 1872, Phileas Fogg was a wealthy and precise English gentleman living in London. At the Reform Club, his friends were discussing a bank robbery and the possibility of traveling around the globe. 'A man can travel around the world in eighty days now,' Fogg said calmly. 'I will bet twenty thousand pounds that I can do it myself!'

chapters.title: Across the Oceans and Deserts
chapters.text: Fogg and Passepartout boarded steamers and trains, racing through Egypt, India, Hong Kong, and across the American continent. Detective Fix followed them secretly, believing Fogg was the bank robber. Through storms, delayed ships, and daring rescues, Fogg never lost his calm determination.

questions.title: A) Kelimeleri Türkçe Anlamlarıyla Eşleştirin (20 Puan)
questions.question: 'ambitious' kelimesinin en doğru Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?
questions.explanation: Ambitious = Hedefleri yüksek olan, hırslı ve kararlı kişi demektir.

questions.title: B) Doğru Zaman Yapısını Seçin (20 Puan)
questions.question: While Ela _______ her homework, her best friend Leo called her.
questions.explanation: 'While' bağlacı arkasından geçmişte devam eden süreci (was doing) alır.

questions.title: C) Present Perfect Deneyim Cümlesi (20 Puan)
questions.question: Have you _______ traveled to an ancient world heritage site?
questions.explanation: Soru cümlelerinde 'hiç yaptın mı?' anlamında 'ever' kullanılır.

questions.title: D) Okuduğunu Anlama (20 Puan)
questions.passage: Steve never gave up when facing computer problems. His ambitious personality and dedication helped him accomplish his dream of building innovative devices.
questions.question: Why did Steve succeed in building innovative devices?
options: Because he had an ambitious personality and perseverance
Because he only played video games
questions.explanation: Metinde Steve'in azimli kişiliği ve sebatı sayesinde başardığı açıkça belirtilmiştir.

questions.title: E) SVOMPT Cümle Dizilimi (20 Puan)
questions.question: 'She / visited / yesterday / Cappadocia / happily' kelimelerinin doğru SVOMPT sıralaması nasıldır?
questions.explanation: SVOMPT kuralı: Subject (She) + Verb (visited) + Object (Cappadocia) + Manner (happily) + Time (yesterday).
